content.value: The design speed of a highway is 80 kmph. There is a horizontal curve (11) of radius 140 km. Calculate the super elevation needed to.maintain this speed. If maximum super elevation of 1 in 15 is not to be exceeded, calculate to the maximum allowable speed on this horizontal curve.
